document_angle_detector_large.onnx.role: fallback global 360-degree regressor (MobileNetV3-Large, [sin,cos]); fallback flag set in 63 of 6300 v4.4 benchmark cases (1.0 %); NOT accurate on its own
document_angle_detector_large.onnx.provenance: the training run was not preserved; trained on synthetic rotations of Tobacco3482 pages (see models/README.md)

pp_lcnet_doc_ori.onnx.role: 4-class page orientation (0/90/180/270 clockwise labels), softmax output

orient_cls_v4.onnx.role: our 4-class page orientation classifier (clockwise 0/90/180/270), 2 views (0 and 180 deg) vote in the pipeline
orient_cls_v4.onnx.provenance: src/train_orientation.py: MobileNetV3-Large fine-tuned from orient_cls_v3 (itself fine-tuned from orient_cls_v1) on audited Tobacco, synthetic Azerbaijani pages, RVL invoices, CORD train receipts, DocLayNet-small pages; args + history in orient_cls_v4.pt / orient_cls_v4_history.json; see MODEL_CARD.md
orient_cls_v4.onnx.license: trained here; ImageNet-pretrained torchvision backbone (BSD-3); weights inherit research-only restrictions of the Tobacco/RVL-CDIP data until the maintainer decides otherwise

orient_cls_v4.pt.role: PyTorch checkpoint of orient_cls_v4 (args, epoch, val metrics inside); needed to retrain/export

orient_cls_v1.onnx.role: first-generation classifier, used ONLY as an independent voter by src/label_audit.py (not by the pipeline)
orient_cls_v1.onnx.provenance: trained on Tobacco3482 pages and synthetic pages (see docs/03-models-and-data.md)

orient_cls_v4_history.json.role: training history of orient_cls_v4 (per-epoch metrics; the arguments are in orient_cls_v4.pt)

_notes: only the files that are present in this folder are listed; the intermediate classifier orient_cls_v3 and the regressor's training checkpoint are not distributed
